biscuit.title: BISCUIT'S GONE AGAIN
offer: MY DOG BISCUIT CHASED A SQUIRREL INTO THE WOODS UP NORTH. THAT WAS THIS MORNING.
HE ALWAYS COMES BACK FOR SUPPER. HE DIDN'T COME BACK FOR SUPPER.
thanks: BISCUIT! YOU DAFT MUTT. COME HERE.
THANK YOU, TRULY. TAKE THIS - MY WIFE'S OLD RING. SHE'D WANT IT WORN.

steps.text: SEARCH THE NORTH WOODS FOR BISCUIT
BISCUIT IS SAFE. CALL HIM OVER
TELL OLD TAM BISCUIT IS HOME

delivery.title: MARLA'S DELIVERY
offer: MARLA WANTS THIS CART OF GOODS DOWN AT HOBB'S FARM BY THE SOUTH ROAD.
TROUBLE IS, GOBLINS LIKE CARTS. AND I LIKE NOT BEING STABBED. WALK WITH ME?
thanks: HOBB: THE SEED SACKS! AND NOT A GOBLIN BITE ON THEM.
HERE'S YOUR CUT. MARLA SAYS YOU'RE ALRIGHT, WHICH FROM MARLA IS PRACTICALLY A HUG.

steps.text: KEEP THE CART SAFE ON THE SOUTH ROAD

goblinCull.title: THIN THE GOBLINS
offer: NOTICE: HEX GOBLINS ARE RAIDING THE VALE ROADS. THE TAVERN PAYS FOR EVERY SIX DRIVEN OFF. - BRUNO
thanks: BRUNO: SIX? THAT'S SIX FEWER GOBLINS DRINKING FROM MY RAIN BARREL. HERE.

moonherb.title: HERBS FOR THE SICK
offer: HALF THE HAMLET HAS CURSE-COUGH. MOONHERB TEA HELPS, BUT MY KNEES DON'T BEND FOR PICKING ANY MORE.
FOUR SPRIGS WOULD DO IT. THEY GROW IN THE MEADOWS - LOOK FOR THE LITTLE BUBBLE MARKS.
thanks: LOVELY AND FRESH. THE KETTLE'S ALREADY ON.
TAKE A COUPLE OF MY POTIONS. I BREW THEM STRONGER THAN MARLA, DON'T TELL HER.

steps.text: BRING THE MOONHERB TO WIDOW ADA

lostRing.title: A RING IN THE REEDS
offer: YOU'VE A KIND FACE. I DROPPED MY WEDDING BAND IN THE LAKE SHALLOWS YEARS AGO, SOUTH SHORE.
THE CURSE MAKES THINGS GLINT AT NIGHT. MAYBE IT GLINTS NOW.
thanks: OH. OH, IT IS. FORTY YEARS AND IT STILL FITS NOBODY BUT ME.
NO - YOU KEEP IT. IT'S DONE ITS JOB. IT'LL KEEP YOU STANDING.

steps.say: A TARNISHED SILVER BAND, STILL WARM SOMEHOW.

steps.text: RETURN THE RING TO WIDOW ADA

bells.title: THE THREE BELLS
offer: HALT. OR DON'T - I CAN'T STOP YOU. I'M A GHOST. SIR OSWIN, LAST WARDEN OF THESE WALLS.
THE OLD BELLS SANG THE KEEP TO SLEEP: LOW, THEN HIGH, THEN THE MIDDLE ONE. RING THEM SO, AND I CAN REST.
thanks: AHH. THERE IT IS. I'D FORGOTTEN HOW THAT SOUNDED.
TAKE WHAT I KNEW OF FIGHTING. I'VE NO MORE USE FOR IT.

steps.text: RING THE BELLS: LOW, HIGH, MIDDLE

ambush.title: TROUBLE ON THE EAST ROAD
offer: HELP! GOBLINS! THEY WANT MY INKWELLS. WHAT DOES A GOBLIN DO WITH AN INKWELL?!
thanks: QUILL: YOU SAVED MY STOCK AND, LESS IMPORTANTLY, ME.
A TRAVELLING SCRIBE PAYS IN GOLD AND GOSSIP. HERE'S THE GOLD.

steps.text: DRIVE OFF THE GOBLINS BEFORE THEY REACH QUILL

npcs.name: OLD TAM
lines: NICE DAY FOR IT. FOR WHAT, I COULDN'T SAY.

npcs.name: PIET
lines: I PUSH CARTS. IT'S A LIVING.

npcs.name: FARMER HOBB
lines: THE FEN STARTS PAST MY FENCE. I DON'T GO PAST MY FENCE.

npcs.name: SIR OSWIN
lines: THE WALLS REMEMBER. I REMEMBER LESS EACH YEAR.

npcs.name: QUILL
lines: NEED ANYTHING WRITTEN? I DO SIGNS, LETTERS AND THREATENING NOTES.

npcs.name: RUMOUR BOARD
lines: PINNED NOTICES. MOST ARE ABOUT A MISSING CHEESE.
